BwGuide.pressPageFromTheMainView: press PAGE from the main view
BwGuide.powerTheRadioConnectUsbChoose: Power the radio, connect USB, choose
BwGuide.onItsScreenThenPressInstall: on its screen, then press Install here. ArduDeck copies the script and points every model's telemetry screen at it, so there is nothing to set up on the radio.
BwGuide.ejectTheCardUnplugUsbThen: Eject the card, unplug USB, then press
BwGuide.fromTheMainViewUntilThe: from the main view until the ArduDeck screen appears. It sits with the radio's other telemetry screens.
BwGuide.topStripFlightModeArmedTimer: Top strip: flight mode, armed timer, link quality. Bottom strip: the vehicle's own messages. Between them, everything is a slot: the big readout, a left column, the horizon (or two more data columns) and a right column. An
BwGuide.beforeTheSignalFigureMeansThe: before the signal figure means the values come from EdgeTX's own sensors rather than passthrough.
BwGuide.clickAnySlotInThePreview: , click any slot in the preview and pick a field. Set a slot to
BwGuide.andItsNeighbourGrowsIntoThe: and its neighbour grows into the free row, so a trimmed layout gets bigger numbers rather than gaps. Apply writes it to the card.
BwGuide.theCalloutsPlayWhetherOrNot: The callouts play whether or not the telemetry screen is open, so you can watch the aircraft: telemetry gained and lost, battery thresholds, fence and EKF warnings. Arming calls stay silent until the vehicle actually reports armed state, rather than guessing.
BwGuide.theHudOnAMonochromeRadio: The HUD on a monochrome radio
BwGuide.pocketBoxerZorroTx12Mt12T: Pocket, Boxer, Zorro, TX12, MT12, T-Lite, X9D

RadioHudView.radioLinkDownCheckRxPower: radio link down - check RX power / binding
RadioHudView.linkUpNoTelemetryFramesElrs: link up, no telemetry frames - ELRS MAVLink mode?
RadioHudView.fcNotStreamingConnectArdudeckTo: FC not streaming - connect ArduDeck to fix rates
RadioHudView.heading: Heading
RadioHudView.clickToFlipPagesRotaryOn: Click to flip pages (rotary / +/- on the radio)
RadioHudView.clickAnySlotToPickWhat: Click any slot to pick what it shows; set one to (empty) and its neighbour grows into the space.
RadioHudView.noVehicleDataYetConnectThe: No vehicle data yet - connect the vehicle once so its parameters can be read
RadioHudView.noRadioFoundPlugInThe: No radio found. Plug in the transmitter via USB and choose "USB Storage (SD)" on its screen, then apply again.
RadioHudView.faithfulMirrorOfLayoutAndColors: Faithful mirror of layout and colors at the selected radio's resolution; the radio renders its own font
RadioHudView.radioModelLayoutsRescaleToIts: Radio model - layouts rescale to its screen
RadioHudView.thePluggedInRadioIdentifiesItself: The plugged-in radio identifies itself in RADIO/radio.yml - apply to the wrong screen class and it installs files the radio cannot use
RadioHudView.howTheHudWorksOnA: How the HUD works on a monochrome radio: installing, opening it, reading it
RadioHudView.howTheHudWorksOnA2: How the HUD works on a monochrome radio: installing it, opening it, reading it
RadioHudView.layoutsLiveInArdudeckAndSave: Layouts live in ArduDeck and save as you edit. The radio only gets the one you apply.
RadioHudView.renamesThisLayoutSavingIsAutomatic: Renames this layout. Saving is automatic.
RadioHudView.startANewLayoutInArdudeck: Start a new layout in ArduDeck. The current one is already saved.
RadioHudView.deleteFromArdudeckWhateverIsAlready: Delete "{{layoutName}}" from ArduDeck. Whatever is already on the radio stays there.
RadioHudView.pageSwipeOnTheRadioTo: Page {{v1}} - swipe on the radio to reach it
RadioHudView.addALayoutPageSwipeLeft: Add a layout page (swipe left/right on the radio to switch)
RadioHudView.dragToMoveCornerHandleTo: Drag to move, corner handle to resize (8px snap). Top bar and message ticker are fixed.
RadioHudView.offlineSatelliteImagesForTheMap: Offline satellite images for the Map tile. Click your field; the rings show each zoom's coverage
RadioHudView.centerTheFieldOnWhereThe: Center the field on where the vehicle is right now
RadioHudView.everythingHereIsAnOverrideLeft: Everything here is an override. Left on auto, the widget configures itself from the vehicle's telemetry - no ArduDeck or FC connection needed
RadioHudView.fillTheFieldsFromTheConnected: Fill the fields from the connected vehicle's parameters
RadioHudView.inANormalWidgetSlotEdgetx: In a normal widget slot EdgeTX gives the widget no keys and no touch, so this is the only way to see every page there. Long-press the widget and choose Full screen to use PAGE and swipe instead.
RadioHudView.printsWhatTheRadioHandsThe: Prints what the radio hands the widget: fullscreen yes/no, the last key event value, the last touch, and which page is showing. For working out why a button does nothing.
RadioHudView.showInputDebugOnTheRadio: Show input debug on the radio
RadioHudView.theRadioAnimatesAScriptedFlight: The radio animates a scripted flight with voice callouts when nothing is connected, badged DEMO. Also toggled by tapping the NO LINK screen
RadioHudView.widgetWillBeInstalledOnApply: - widget will be installed on apply
RadioHudView.onlyUsesThisLayoutTheRest: - only "{{applyTarget}}" uses this layout, the rest keep the shared one
RadioHudView.everyModelUsesThisLayoutUnless: - every model uses this layout unless it has its own
RadioHudView.lookingForARadioPlugIn: Looking for a radio. Plug in via USB and choose USB Storage (SD) on its screen; it takes a few seconds to appear.
RadioHudView.deleteTheArdudeckWidgetAndIts: Delete the ArduDeck widget and its config from the SD card (only files we installed)
RadioHudView.noArdudeckConfigFoundOnThe: No ArduDeck config found on the card
RadioHudView.readTheConfigAndTileLayout: Read the config and tile layout currently on the SD card into the editor
RadioHudView.safelyEjectTheSdVolumeSo: Safely eject the SD volume so the radio can leave USB storage mode
RadioHudView.whichLayoutApplyWritesAndLoad: Which layout Apply writes and Load reads. Models share one layout unless you give a model its own; the radio then uses that one whenever the model is selected.
RadioHudView.installRefreshTheWidgetAndWrite: Install/refresh the widget and write this layout to the SD card. Afterwards on the radio: App layout, full-screen widget, ArduDeck
